One transport action for a connection: drop a revoked partition, or send its snapshot or delta chain.

Per-connection progress for one subscribed partition: acknowledged revision plus at most one unacknowledged send.
What one subscriber needs next: nothing, a full snapshot, or the retained contiguous delta chain from its acknowledged revision.
Client cache of one subscribed partition: lineage epoch, applied revision and validated view.
Server-owned hot state of one partition. epoch changes whenever revisions restart, so old acknowledgements never match a new lineage.
Advance the baseline only for the matching epoch and pending revision; stale, duplicate, and reordered ACKs are ignored.
Diff the retained view against a new projection exactly once. Budget or operation overflow resets history instead of emitting a partial patch.
Apply a delta chain atomically: epoch and every base revision must match and decode-view must accept the final view, otherwise the cached slot is left untouched.
Plan one connection's transport work: drops for partitions it may no longer see, then snapshots or retained delta chains for authorized partitions.
